name: Search Tasks
description: Searches for a Task by name within a Project. [See the documentation](https://developers.asana.com/docs/get-multiple-tasks)

configurable_props.name: project
configurable_props.label: Project
configurable_props.description: List of projects. This field uses the project GID.

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: The task name to search for.

configurable_props.name: assignee
configurable_props.label: Assignee
configurable_props.description: The assignee to filter tasks on

configurable_props.name: section
configurable_props.label: Section
configurable_props.description: The section to filter tasks on. Must specify Project to list options.

configurable_props.name: completedSince
configurable_props.label: Completed Since
configurable_props.description: Only return tasks that are either incomplete or that have been completed since this time. ISO 8601 date string

configurable_props.name: modifiedSince
configurable_props.label: Modified Since
configurable_props.description: Only return tasks that have been modified since the given time. ISO 8601 date string
